description:
Pike has had the blast door for eleven years and has never once asked anybody to take it for an hour.

He is asking now, and the reason he gives is that his mug is empty, which isn't the reason.

The job is the door. Nothing comes through it. Nothing has come through it in eleven years, which is the argument for sitting there and not the argument against.
name: The Door

objectives.desc: Take the stool at the blast door until Pike comes back.
emotes: {who} sits down at a sealed door with their back to a wall for the first time in their life.
{who} learns that the door makes a noise about once an hour and that the noise is nothing.
{who} checks the seam at the hinge side twice, because Pike checks it twice.

objectives.desc: Hand the door back to Pike.
